- Improve the existing OVERLAND game with more realistic hills and jumps, controllable midair rotation for landing, and recognizable real vehicles from major manufacturers.

- Build on the existing playable game; do not ask clarifying questions.

- Replaced fictional vehicle names and adjusted vehicle specs in `game.js`.
- Updated terrain with layered, smooth ridgelines.
- Reworked jump and landing physics to include gravity, midair angular input, wheel-contact slopes, impact damage, and clean-landing rewards.

- `game.js`: Vehicle definitions, terrain, physics, and input handling.

## Objective
- Improve the existing OVERLAND game with more realistic hills and jumps, controllable midair rotation for landing, and recognizable real vehicles from major manufacturers.
- Finish touch controls and control hints, then browser-test gameplay and capture a current screenshot.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing playable game; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Vehicle lineup: Toyota Tacoma TRD Pro, Ford Bronco Raptor, Jeep Wrangler Rubicon, Land Rover Defender 110, and Porsche 911 Dakar.
- Use smooth, varied ridgelines and gravity-based jump and landing physics.
- Midair rotation uses W/ArrowUp and S/ArrowDown; touch controls should provide the same pitch inputs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated vehicle names and specs, terrain ridgelines, and jump/landing physics in `game.js`.
- Confirmed `game.js` parses with `node --check game.js`.

### Active
- Add mobile touch pitch controls and update keyboard/mobile control hints.
- Browser-test driving, jumps, and landings; fix issues and capture a current screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add touch pitch buttons and update control hints in `index.html` and `game.js`; adjust `style.css` as needed.
2. Run the game in a browser and test driving, jumps, and landing behavior.
3. Fix issues, capture a current screenshot, and summarize the changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Vehicle definitions, terrain, physics, keyboard/touch input handling.
- `index.html`: HUD, control hints, and touch controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive layout and touch-control styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `game.js` is modified, and `index.html`/`style.css` have not yet been changed.
- `touch` already has `pitchUp` and `pitchDown` states, and physics reads them; touch buttons currently expose only brake, jump, gas, and NOS.
- Desktop hints list A/D drive, W/↑ lean, SPACE jump, SHIFT NOS, and G garage. Mobile start instructions do not yet explain touch pitch controls.
